resize_detector_outputs: resize raw R-CNN detector output instances to match the desired output image resolution
scale_prediction_boxes: scale and clip predicted bounding boxes to fit the target output dimensions
convert_roi_masks_to_bitmasks: convert ROIMasks prediction tensors to full-resolution bitmasks using a configurable threshold
scale_prediction_keypoints: scale predicted keypoint coordinates to match the target output image resolution
resize_semantic_segmentation: resize semantic segmentation prediction logits to the desired output resolution using bilinear interpolation
